description:
HushMessenger for Messenger 583.0.0.29.95, now all 18 arm64 and armv7 builds, including the one Morphe Manager's download button opens. 61 patches. This fork release is based on 0.25.0 and adds the four armv7 builds beside the arm64 ones. New switches for opening your own gallery app, holding stories at the end, a Mark as read button and stopping app list and device ID sharing, all off until you turn them on. HD photos keep their full size, and Fix videos that won't send works on videos you pick in a chat too. Source updates don't change installed apps.

### New

- **armv7 builds of Messenger 583.0.0.29.95 work now.** HushMessenger adds four 32-bit builds (`346611347`, `346611363`, `346611416`, `346611433`) beside the arm64 builds. The patches find their spots in the armv7 DEX through their own recorded profiles, including the two-launch Instagram link handler, the native bubble holder, the constant-margin video check and the extra AI sticker cell. Morphe Desktop applied all 58 default patches to each of the four, plus Clone install on both armv7 mappings, and rebuilt them. The README lists every version code with its SHA-256.
